elements.requirement: The total amount payable to an employee in respect of any debt to which this Part applies, where the amount of the debt is referable to a period of time, shall not exceed £508 in respect of any one week.
elements.quote: shall not exceed— (a) £508 in respect of any one week

elements.requirement: The total amount payable to an employee in respect of any debt to which this Part applies, where the amount of the debt is referable to a period of time shorter than a week, shall not exceed an amount bearing the same proportion to £508 as that shorter period bears to a week.
elements.quote: (b) in respect of a shorter period, an amount bearing the same proportion to £508 as that shorter period bears to a week

thresholds.what: the maximum total amount payable to an employee in respect of a debt referable to any one week

thresholds.what: the period of time to which the £508 maximum amount payable applies
